verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a scoped auditor role, auditor portal, or auditor login for reviewing controls and evidence inside Drata. The only audit-related items are API endpoints ('List Audits', 'Get Audit'), which are developer building blocks rather than an auditor-facing view, so they earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a compliance-automation platform, so the absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs
